using System;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Options;
using Orleans.Clustering.AzureStorage;

namespace Orleans.AzureUtils
{
    public class AzureStorageClusteringOptionsValidator : IConfigurationValidator
    {
        private readonly AzureStorageClusteringOptions _options;
        private readonly string _sectionName;

        public AzureStorageClusteringOptionsValidator(AzureStorageClusteringOptions options, string sectionName)
        {
            _options = options;
            _sectionName = sectionName;
        }

        public void Validate()
        {
            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(_options.TableName))
            {
                throw new InvalidOperationException("TableName is required");
            }

            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(_options.StorageConnectionString))
            {
                throw new InvalidOperationException("StorageConnectionString is required");
            }

            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(_options.AzureStorageAccountName))
            {
                throw new InvalidOperationException("AzureStorageAccountName is required");
            }

            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(_options.AzureStorageAccountKey))
            {
                throw new InvalidOperationException("AzureStorageAccountKey is required");
            }

            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(_options.AzureStorageAccountConnectionString))
            {
                throw new InvalidOperationException("AzureStorageAccountConnectionString is required");
            }

            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(_options.AzureStorageAccountBlobEndpoint))
            {
                throw new InvalidOperationException("AzureStorageAccountBlobEndpoint is required");
            }

            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(_options.AzureStorageAccountQueueEndpoint))
            {
                throw new InvalidOperationException("AzureStorageAccountQueueEndpoint is required");
            }

            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(_options.AzureStorageAccountTableEndpoint))
            {
                throw new InvalidOperationException("AzureStorageAccountTableEndpoint is required");
            }
        }
    }
}

namespace Orleans.Hosting.Tests
{
    public class AzureTableClusteringExtensionsTests
    {
        [Fact]
        public void UseAzureStorageClustering_ValidOptions_ConfiguresServices()
        {
            // Arrange
            var services = new ServiceCollection();
            var configureOptions = new Action<OptionsBuilder<AzureStorageClusteringOptions>>(options =>
            {
                options.Configure(options => options.TableName = "TestTable");
            });

            // Act
            var builder = new SiloBuilder();
            builder.UseAzureStorageClustering(configureOptions);

            // Assert
            var serviceProvider = services.BuildServiceProvider();
            var azureStorageClusteringOptions = serviceProvider.GetService<IOptions<AzureStorageClusteringOptions>>();
            Assert.NotNull(azureStorageClusteringOptions);
            Assert.Equal("TestTable", azureStorageClusteringOptions.Value.TableName);
        }

        [Fact]
        public void UseAzureStorageClustering_InvalidOptions_ThrowsException()
        {
            // Arrange
            var services = new ServiceCollection();
            var configureOptions = new Action<OptionsBuilder<AzureStorageClusteringOptions>>(options =>
            {
                options.Configure(options => options.TableName = null);
            });

            // Act and Assert
            var builder = new SiloBuilder();
            Assert.Throws<InvalidOperationException>(() => builder.UseAzureStorageClustering(configureOptions));
        }

        [Fact]
        public void UseAzureStorageClustering_GetRequiredService_CallsGetRequiredService()
        {
            // Arrange
            var services = new ServiceCollection();
            var configureOptions = new Action<OptionsBuilder<AzureStorageClusteringOptions>>(options =>
            {
                options.Configure(options => options.TableName = "TestTable");
            });
            var serviceProviderMock = new Mock<IServiceProvider>();
            serviceProviderMock.Setup(sp => sp.GetRequiredService<IOptionsMonitor<AzureStorageClusteringOptions>>()).Returns(new OptionsMonitor<AzureStorageClusteringOptions>(new AzureStorageClusteringOptions()));

            // Act
            var builder = new SiloBuilder();
            builder.UseAzureStorageClustering(configureOptions);

            // Assert
            serviceProviderMock.Verify(sp => sp.GetRequiredService<IOptionsMonitor<AzureStorageClusteringOptions>>(), Times.Once);
        }
    }
}
